name: Mamluk Conquest Ends Cilician Armenia
summary: The Mamluk Sultanate conquered the Kingdom of Cilician Armenia in 1375 CE, ending the last Armenian state until the 20th century. The last king Leo V was captured and eventually ransomed, spending the rest of his life seeking in vain to organise a crusade for the kingdoms recovery. Armenian nobles and commoners dispersed across Europe and the Mediterranean.
